 Al-Nassr and Al Kholood meet in round 12 of the Saudi Pro League 2026/27 at Al Awwal Park on Thursday 29 October, with kick-off scheduled for 15:00 (UK time).
 Al-Nassr sit second in the table, two points behind leaders Al Hilal, after winning four consecutive matches across all competitions. Ange Postecoglou’s side have been faultless at home in the league, taking maximum points from five games while conceding only twice. Al Kholood arrive in sharp decline under Des Buckingham, having lost four straight league fixtures and conceded 13 goals in that sequence. Winless on the road this term, the visitors face the division’s meanest home defense.
 Our prediction for Al-Nassr vs. Al Kholood backs the hosts to control proceedings and secure a decisive multi-goal victory. Find out our betting tips and analysis for this encounter.

 Al-Nassr vs. Al Kholood - Head-to-head record
 Across four competitive meetings, Al-Nassr are unbeaten with three victories and one draw .
 The clubs first met in October 2024, playing out a 3-3 draw in Ar Rass. Since that fixture, Al-Nassr have won three consecutive meetings by an aggregate scoreline of 8-1, including a 3-0 away victory in their most recent encounter in January 2026.
 At Al Awwal Park, Al-Nassr have won both previous encounters comfortably (3-1 and 2-0).
 With Al Kholood struggling defensively on the road, past form points toward another dominant home display .

 Al-Nassr - On an impressive winning streak
 Ange Postecoglou’s side enter Thursday aiming to keep pace in the title race, having won eight of their opening 10 league matches. Below is an overview of the hosts’ current form, team news, and projected starting XI:
 Recent form
 The Knights of Najd are in strong domestic form, recording four straight wins across all competitions since their only league defeat of the season against Al Ittihad.
 Friday’s 3-1 away win over Al Faisaly featured goals from Abdullah Al-Hamdan, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Ângelo Gabriel.
 At Al Awwal Park, Al-Nassr have won all five league games this season, scoring 11 goals and allowing only two .
 Postecoglou remains without right-back Sultan Al Ghannam due to a cruciate ligament injury, while winger Abdulrahman Ghareeb is sidelined with a foot problem. Mohamed Simakan (leg) and Kingsley Coman (hamstring) are doubtful.
 Brazilian goalkeeper Bento starts behind a back four of Nawaf Boushal, Abdulelah Al-Amri, Íñigo Martínez, and Awad Aman.
 In midfield, Abdullah Al Khaibari and Samu Costa provide defensive cover, allowing João Félix (three goals, three assists) and Sadio Mané (four assists) to link up with Abdullah Al-Hamdan and Cristiano Ronaldo in attack.

 Al Kholood - Looking to end losing streak
 Des Buckingham’s side travel to Riyadh looking to halt a slide that has seen them drop to ninth in the standings on 12 points. Here is an examination of the visitors’ tactical setup, defensive frailties, and expected starting lineup ahead of kickoff:
 Recent form
 After going unbeaten in their first six league matches (three wins, three draws), Al Kholood have collapsed defensively, losing four consecutive league games against Al Riyadh (2-0), Al Qadsiah (5-0), Al Faisaly (3-2), and Al-Ettifaq (3-0).
 Their 21 goals conceded this season is the second-worst defensive tally in the division.
 On their travels, the Pride of Ar Rass remain winless, taking three draws and two defeats from five away outings.
 Buckingham has a fully fit squad to choose from and is expected to retain his 4-3-3 structure. Hamed Al-Shanqiti starts in goal behind central defenders Shaquille Pinas and Mansour Camara, flanked by full-backs Ramzi Solan and Sultan Al Shehri.
 In midfield, John Buckley anchors alongside Yaseen Al-Zubaidi and Spanish attacking midfielder Iker Kortajarena, who has four league goals.
 In attack, French forward Julien Domingues leads the line with four goals and two assists, flanked by Coba da Costa and Guga.

 Predictions for Al-Nassr vs. Al Kholood - Goals Expected in Riyadh
 Al-Nassr have scored at least three goals in three of their four historical meetings with Al Kholood. Facing a defense that has conceded 13 times in its last four outings, the hosts should create regular scoring chances from the outset. Backing Al-Nassr to lead at half-time is a solid primary angle.
 Al Kholood have conceded two or more goals in four consecutive matches and have failed to win away from home all season. With Al-Nassr averaging 2.3 goals per game in the league and allowing just 0.4 goals per match at home, backing Over 2.5 total goals fits both teams’ profiles.
 The technical difference between the sides is substantial. Al-Nassr have greater individual quality through João Félix, Mané, and Ronaldo, while Al Kholood are short of confidence following four straight defeats. Back Al-Nassr on the -1.5 Asian Handicap line to win by at least two clear goals.
